stories.title: Qualify FinOps automation, billing isolation and shared typed contracts
stories.outcome: Qualify a supported native cost-inquiry and read-only recovery path, and freeze the scoped request/result contract without inventing a provider API.
stories.owned: Existing shared contracts/v1, run_input.py, adapters/protocol.py, configuration registration and host discriminators; proposed FinOps qualification record and typed payload variant. Coordinate shared edits with DA09 #8874 / PR #9081 and SA01 #8683; do not replace sibling contracts.
stories.io: Input: current provider documentation, authorized view/data-role fixture and Product contract. Output: dated support/scope/recovery matrix, FinopsRunInput/FinopsCostResult schemas, capability-specific readiness, catalog mapping and compatible client/worker variants. Existing router accepts Security/DevOps, not FinOps.
stories.deploy: Contract preparation is independent of live access. A qualified provider path is required before its dependent native implementation/activation; FO07 integrates schema/host/worker release. No provider setup or paid inquiry is authorized by filing.

acceptance.action: Inspect the supported provider surface and use an authorized qualification fixture for identity/read-only recovery, including expiry.
acceptance.expected: Record versioned evidence of supported automation, agent/conversation/turn correlation, read-only resume and limits. Missing proof is explicit unsupported/blocked; no fabricated SDK or hidden endpoint. A native-ready declaration requires actual qualified observations.
acceptance.evidence: qualification record + private readbacks; unqualified native ECs remain incomplete

acceptance.action: Validate FinOps payloads through shared route/runtime schemas alongside unchanged Security/DevOps fixtures.
acceptance.expected: Accept scoped fixed-period cost queries without a repository; reject unknown fields, caller view/role, invalid dates and unsupported metrics. Same old fixtures retain their prior behavior.
acceptance.evidence: schema/host contract tests and independent error assertions

acceptance.action: Inspect selected view contents and provider data-role policy; exercise owned and controlled foreign-view paths.
acceptance.expected: Only selected billing is readable; foreign view denied through actual provider/data-role execution, not merely a CE filter or IAM simulation. No default primary view or scope widening.
acceptance.evidence: scope matrix + permitted/denied native readbacks

acceptance.action: Resolve Product capability/catalog mapping with SA01 and inspect Profile inputs.
acceptance.expected: Registered Module/Feature IDs or owned unresolved status, not invented IDs; only inquiry-relevant prerequisites block readiness. Allocation proposals never become spending authority.
acceptance.evidence: catalog readback, Profile mapping and readiness counterexamples

stories.title: Configure scoped FinOps bindings and owned setup or adoption
stories.outcome: Let an entitled project select a billing scope and create or adopt its own native agent without widening access or losing resource ownership.
stories.owned: Existing configuration_population.py, configuration_readiness.py, models/binding.py, models/setup.py, binding APIs/workers and gateway l5_integration.py; proposed adapters/finops/setup.py and additive shared retained-agent scope uniqueness migration.
stories.io: Input: Product API Profile revision, explicit connection/region/view/data-role selections and create/adopt intent. Output: configuration ETag/readiness, persistent binding generation and durable setup/retirement receipts. Save/check have no provider effects; startBindingOperation is the shared setup interface.
stories.deploy: FO02 owns setup/cleanup semantics and migrations; FO07 deploys compatible batch. Setup is separate from inquiries; retain adopted agents/views/roles and all results. Unknown partial setup is reconciled, never blindly recreated.

acceptance.action: Save/check/refresh a FinOps configuration with optional Profile fields absent and explicit choices present.
acceptance.expected: Keep authorized choices and immutable Profile provenance; stale ETag fails; no setup effect from save/check. Missing repository never blocks account inquiry; missing qualified billing does.
acceptance.evidence: API/SQL and provider-call-counter assertions

acceptance.action: Create/adopt through startBindingOperation using two projects and concurrent claims on the same native agent.
acceptance.expected: Correct selected role/view bound and verified; foreign tenant/project/view denied. One context-bearing agent cannot bind to two project scopes, including cross-tenant attempts; masked conflict, no credential leak.
acceptance.evidence: PostgreSQL race test + private native scope readback

acceptance.action: Interrupt setup after each owned resource, replay intent, then retire owned and adopted fixtures.
acceptance.expected: Same intent reconciles without duplicate creation; only owned unreferenced resources are removed and absence verified. Adopted resources/results persist; cleanup uncertainty remains visible and repairable.
acceptance.evidence: fault-injection receipts + owned/adopted disposition report

stories.title: Execute native FinOps inquiries with durable identity and read-only recovery
stories.outcome: Submit an admitted native cost question once and recover its answer without automatically sending another turn after interruption or session expiry.
stories.owned: Existing admission.py, workers/execution.py, workers/recovery.py, work_store.py, models/attempt.py and gateway host; proposed adapters/finops/inquiry.py and qualified protected executor. Share manifest/dispatch extensions with DevOps DA09, not a second worker engine.
stories.io: Input: frozen FinopsRunInput plus pinned binding/configuration and current delegation/budget. Output: 202 run/receipt, durable attempt/question hash/native conversation-turn identity, observations and native answer. Existing AssessmentAdapter methods are reused; FinOps executor selection depends on FO01 qualification.
stories.deploy: FO03 owns private executor integration and bounded actions; FO07 packages/releases it with shared transport. No public Lambda URL or client-visible session. Preserve repair and native identity on rollback.

acceptance.action: Submit through the real L5 API, duplicate the request, lose queue acknowledgment and restart execution after native acceptance.
acceptance.expected: One run/receipt and at most one native submit; SQL attempt precedes effect. Reconcile the same native identity or expose outcome_unknown. Same key/different body conflicts.
acceptance.evidence: SQL/SQS fault trace + independent native turn count/readback

acceptance.action: Expire a session or revoke delegation between submit and observation; then restart or explicitly reconcile.
acceptance.expected: No new conversation/turn. Reauthorized refresh observes same inquiry; denied/ambiguous readback stays blocked/unknown. Persisted limits do not reset. No session material in public artifacts/logs.
acceptance.evidence: expiry/revocation trace, provider count and redaction checks

acceptance.action: Cancel/expire an active inquiry and inject lost answer-storage acknowledgment.
acceptance.expected: Local cancellation never claims unsupported native stop; saved answer reuses identity. Collection/publication repair cannot call submit; refusal is not automatically rephrased.
acceptance.evidence: worker transition tests + native status/answer readback

stories.title: Reconcile native answers with complete independent billing evidence
stories.outcome: Return trustworthy native cost results with independent billing comparison, preserving precision, credits, scope and missing-data limitations.
stories.owned: Existing result/evidence models, api/results.py and collection worker transitions; proposed adapters/finops/billing.py, result normalizer and l5_service_cost_collections migration. Do not coerce cost data into Security findings.
stories.io: Input: original native answer/identity and exact pinned scope/query. Output: FinopsCostResult with separate native and CE provenance, complete page evidence, signed decimal strings, Estimated/freshness/coverage and comparison status. CE-only output is not a native answer.
stories.deploy: FO04 owns additive collection/result schema; FO07 deploys readers before producers. Native result survives billing/publication failures and owned cleanup; rollback retains immutable evidence/checkpoints.

acceptance.action: Collect a native answer and all CE pages for identical scope/period/metric/currency/Estimated, including signed credit groups.
acceptance.expected: 10.125 plus -0.125 equals 10.000 exactly; 0.00000001 stays nonzero. Every group and total reconciles with Decimal; rounded display is distinct from exact and mismatched dimensions never compare equal.
acceptance.evidence: independent fixed-value oracle + native/CE raw evidence

acceptance.action: Feed missing/partial/stale billing, empty pages, unknown Estimated/freshness and account-only attribution.
acceptance.expected: Unavailable amount is null, not zero; complete explicit zero remains zero. Unknown freshness/Estimated stay unknown; account costs never labelled Product-attributed without proof. Results retain original scope/time.
acceptance.evidence: negative result/API assertions with independently defined fixtures

acceptance.action: Lose a CE-page acknowledgment; repeat a token; exceed admitted limit; expire a cursor and resume collection.
acceptance.expected: Bounded calls/checkpointed pages, no cross-collection mixing or false completeness. New collection supersedes invalid cursor; native turn count unchanged; result/evidence survives provider cleanup.
acceptance.evidence: page-sequence fault report + request ledger/native count

stories.title: Expose FinOps configuration, inquiries and answers consistently in UI CLI and MCP
stories.outcome: Let users and agents configure, ask, observe and read the same scoped FinOps inquiry through the Product UI, installed CLI and authenticated MCP.
stories.owned: Existing gateway Product workspace, frontend/src/services/products.ts, CLI command manifest/install path and tools facade catalog; proposed shared adp service FinOps commands and l5___ operation registrations. Domain logic stays in L5.
stories.io: Input: explicit Product/project/service route scope and shared schema arguments. Output: identical configuration/setup/run/result/publication envelopes and errors. Show pending/blocked/partial/unknown honestly; no native session or direct provider client.
stories.deploy: FO05 owns host/UI/installed CLI/tool integration. Keep normal gateway/frontend auto-deploys; FO07 checks all installed artifacts against compatible worker/schema release. No per-project deployment.

acceptance.action: Use served UI, installed CLI and authenticated MCP to configure, set up, submit and read one inquiry.
acceptance.expected: Same scoped state/ETag/receipt/run/result across clients; no direct provider calls or credentials in responses. 202 shown as accepted, not completed.
acceptance.evidence: three-client journeys + API and provider readback

acceptance.action: Switch to another project/tenant and replay IDs/cursors/keys; exercise stale ETag and invalid query.
acceptance.expected: Masked inaccessible resource/authorization failure; no cross-scope cache or artifact leak. 412/422/428/409 semantics match; idempotent replay remains reauthorized.
acceptance.evidence: host/client negative assertions and artifact access denial

acceptance.action: Read partial/unknown/refused results; request explicit wait and read-only recovery in installed clients.
acceptance.expected: Original answer and independent evidence remain distinct; null/Decimal preserved. Documented wait exit/error states; no hidden resubmit, rephrase or DevOps federation reuse.
acceptance.evidence: installed JSON/exit-code and UI/MCP response checks

stories.title: Publish reusable FinOps context and opt-in periodic cost reports
stories.outcome: Publish cost results for later entitled work and issue explicitly enabled periodic reports without duplicating paid turns.
stories.owned: Existing events/schedules.py, event receipts/recovery and shared publication/peer contracts; proposed FinOps result contribution variant and scheduled cost-query snapshot. Coordinate SA11 #8693 and Context/Insights owners; no new scheduler/control plane.
stories.io: Input: immutable result/version/scope and enabled schedule with UTC tick/template. Output: independent consumer receipts and later authorized retrieval, or explicit retry/block; periodic tick freezes the same FinopsRunInput used by manual admission.
stories.deploy: FO06 owns producer/consumer contract integration with peer owners; FO07 wires/verifies actual schedule ingress and release. Result/publication repair never repeats native work; revoked destinations remain denied.

acceptance.action: Publish a result, lose consumer acknowledgment, replay, then read consumer projection.
acceptance.expected: One semantic contribution per result/version/consumer; independent receipts/readback for Context and Insights. Stored result survives outage, no new provider turn.
acceptance.evidence: consumer receipts + projection and provider-count assertions

acceptance.action: Run a later distinct entitled task, then revoke source/Product access and repeat retrieval.
acceptance.expected: Later task retrieves and uses original cost scope/period/Estimated/freshness with citations; revoked/foreign task cannot retrieve indexed or artifact copies.
acceptance.evidence: later-task retrieval/use trace + controlled denial

acceptance.action: Enable a monthly report; replay one tick across month boundary; disable/revoke before another tick.
acceptance.expected: One frozen closed interval and inquiry per scoped tick; no retry-time interval drift or catch-up burst. Disabled/revoked tick rejects; existing budget and dedup apply.
acceptance.evidence: fixed-clock schedule/API/worker integration + live replay

stories.title: Release FinOps compatibly and prove portable scoped native acceptance
stories.outcome: Integrate one compatible FinOps release and prove its native results, recovery, reuse and cleanup on two non-ADP projects.
stories.owned: Existing L5 scripts/infra/tests, gateway migrations/packaging/workflows and platform launcher/release integration; proposed tests/live/FinOps cases and finops/runbook.md. Reuse Security SA15 #8698 / PR #8932; exact file lists are advisory, never node failure gates.
stories.io: Input: prior slices, selected private target/access/budget, compatible artifact identities and two distinct controlled cost scopes. Output: installed release identity, EC-to-AC evidence, costs/disposition and recovery/runbook. No new AWS authority from the issue.
stories.deploy: FO07 release implementer owns integration, allowed deployment, live tests and defect closure; PranavSharma1000 coordinates/accepts. Retain normal host auto-deploys, one coordinated L5 release per compatible batch; never equate CI/merge with live acceptance.

acceptance.action: Release additive schema, compatible package/workers/clients and enabled fixtures; test fresh/existing/pending work and rollback.
acceptance.expected: Installed components match manifest; queue/repair/schedule ingress work. Rollback disables new admissions but preserves observations/results/cleanup; no schema/evidence loss.
acceptance.evidence: release identity + migration/worker/rollback readbacks

acceptance.action: Use same release on two non-ADP projects with distinct effective billing scopes; ask fixed native inquiries and attempt controlled foreign access.
acceptance.expected: Both reconcile with complete CE evidence without platform edits/redeploy. Foreign view/tenant/project denied through real path; no unrequested enrollment or widening.
acceptance.evidence: two native answers, CE comparison, denial and unchanged artifact digests

acceptance.action: Interrupt worker/submit acknowledgment/session, CE collection and publication; exercise installed clients and zero/missing/credit cases.
acceptance.expected: Same inquiry identity, no duplicate native turn; bounded repair; unknown/partial explicit. Clients retain scope, exact Decimal and original answer, not synthetic success.
acceptance.evidence: fault matrix + real queue/provider/client observations

acceptance.action: Publish and reuse results, retire owned resources, verify adopted retention and attempt denied reuse.
acceptance.expected: Consumer acknowledgments and later entitled use proven; owned absence verified, adopted/result retention preserved; current denial enforced. Costs distinguish measured/estimated/unknown; every EC mapped to proof.
acceptance.evidence: consumer/task traces + cleanup/cost report at tested revision
